bugs.name: After sign-out, browser Back shows the cached signed-in notifications page
bugs.summary: The browser goes back to /notifications?q=pinned and renders the whole signed-in notifications page again: the notification row "eval/harbor-handbook #8 agent3-notif-alpha" with its time, the Unread/Read tab bar, the notification bell and the eval avatar in the top bar. The session is really gone — clicking the notification row then redirects to /user/login — but the notification content is shown as if still signed in (seen 2 times: once via ?q=read after signing out of eval, once via ?q=pinned). (on /notifications?q=pinned)
bugs.expected: After signing out, pressing Back must not show the signed-in notifications page: the browser should land on the sign-in page (or a page with no notification titles, no bell and no avatar).
bugs.actual: The browser goes back to /notifications?q=pinned and renders the whole signed-in notifications page again: the notification row "eval/harbor-handbook #8 agent3-notif-alpha" with its time, the Unread/Read tab bar, the notification bell and the eval avatar in the top bar. The session is really gone — clicking the notification row then redirects to /user/login — but the notification content is shown as if still signed in (seen 2 times: once via ?q=read after signing out of eval, once via ?q=pinned).
reproSteps: Open https://5503-iqgs3fdkdmn70ntvor14g.e2b.app/notifications?q=pinned (a notification is listed, e.g. 'eval/harbor-handbook #8 agent3-notif-alpha').
Click the avatar in the top-right corner, then click 'Sign Out'. The home page with a Sign In button is shown.
bugs.reason: The session is really ended (the finding itself notes the next click redirects to /user/login); what Back shows is the browser's own cached copy. Gitea deliberately sends 'max-age=0, private, must-revalidate' instead of 'no-store' and says why in the source, so cached history pages are a chosen trade-off, the same header policy GitHub uses.

bugs.name: Pinning a notification clears its unread count
bugs.summary: The pin also marks the notification as read: right after the click the bell badge and the \"Unread\" tab count both disappear (1 → none), the row is gone from /notifications?q=unread (\"No unread notifications.\") and appears under /notifications?q=read. The unread state is silently lost and unpinning does not bring it back. Seen on the row of eval/harbor-handbook #4 and of eval/harbor-handbook #1. (on /notifications)
bugs.expected: Pinning only pins: the notification keeps its unread state, the bell and \"Unread\" tab count stay 1 and the row stays in the Unread tab, with a pinned marker.
bugs.actual: The pin also marks the notification as read: right after the click the bell badge and the \"Unread\" tab count both disappear (1 → none), the row is gone from /notifications?q=unread (\"No unread notifications.\") and appears under /notifications?q=read. The unread state is silently lost and unpinning does not bring it back. Seen on the row of eval/harbor-handbook #4 and of eval/harbor-handbook #1.
reproSteps: Sign in as alex / momentic-contributor-1 (the same happens on eval).

Open https://5503-iousaqru19me2ux8s0kmc.e2b.app/notifications?q=unread — there is 1 unread notification (eval/harbor-handbook #4 "Review the release ownership proposal"); the bell badge and the "Unread" tab both show 1.
Hover that row so its two icons appear and click the pin icon ("Pin notification").
Look at the bell and the "Unread" tab badge, then open /notifications?q=read and /notifications?q=unread.
Repeat with a second notification: on /notifications?q=read hover eval/harbor-handbook #1 and click "Mark as unread" (badge goes back to 1), then on the list hover it and click "Pin notification".
bugs.reason: In Gitea a notification has one status with three exclusive values (unread, read, pinned), so pinning replaces 'unread' and the badge counts only status unread; pinned rows are deliberately listed in both tabs. The screenshots also contradict the report's claim that the row leaves the Unread tab: it stays there with a pin icon.
